newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fiat recalls Brava/Bravo models.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fiat recalls Brava/Bravo models.

text.p: Italian car maker Fiat said on Thursday it was recalling all its popular Brava/Bravo 1.4 saloon models to replace a brake component after problems were reported with the car in Germany.

In a statement, Fiat said: "Fiat Auto has decided to initiate a recall campaign on Fiat Bravo and Brava 1.4 models, replacing the brake servo depression pipe. This modification has already been applied to vehicles in production."

A Fiat spokesman said that a number of clients in Germany had experienced a hardening of the brake pedal which appeared to have been brought on when the car was driven at high speed over long distances in "particular climatic conditions".
The problem had not been reported in any other country.
"This is not a safety-related problem for should there be a reduction, or at worst, loss of servo-assistance, the hydraulic braking system maintains its full efficiency," the statement said.
Fiat did not state how many vehicles were involved in the recall.
